name: Cordillera Huayhuash circuit
why: One of the great treks on Earth: ten days round a wall of ice peaks, over passes at 5,000 m, camping by lakes.
book: Each community you cross charges a fee in cash (soles): carry the full amount. Agencies in Huaraz run it with donkeys and a cook.
dangers: Several passes around 4,700-5,000 m; nights below -10 °C.
Very remote: a rescue takes days.

points.name: Quartelhuain
points.note: Day 1 camp at the road end, after 6-7 h by road from Huaraz.

points.name: Laguna Carhuacocha with Yerupajá
points.note: Day 3: the most famous camp, Yerupajá and Siula Grande over the lake.

points.name: Siula pass and the Tres Lagunas
points.note: Day 4: three glacier lakes one above the other from the pass.

points.name: Laguna Jahuacocha
points.note: The last great camp, under the west face of Yerupajá.
